verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app that you install with Docker, npm or a Helm chart, or deploy remotely. The operator chooses the infrastructure, so stored conversation data lives wherever they host it. Custom endpoints such as Ollama also let model traffic stay on infrastructure the user picks. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or storage-location documentation, docs on where databases and files are stored, independent corroboration of residency control.
